# v0.1.0-rc.3: MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer Release Candidate

This tag is a **Release Candidate** for evaluation only. It is not a final
production release.

## Product overview

MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer is a local-first desktop application for CSV/XLSX
cloud billing preparation.

It helps you inspect billing exports on your device, protect sensitive
identifiers, and generate an analysis-ready sanitized copy for later FinOps
work—without uploading data or connecting to cloud accounts.

## Changes

- Public documentation boundary improvements
- Release documentation alignment

## Security

- No cloud connection during sanitization
- No automatic upload
- Sensitive identifier protection with Stable Pseudonymization

## Status

**Release Candidate for evaluation only.**

Do not treat this candidate as a production release, a fully signed binary set,
or a complete enterprise release.
